title: Proton pump inhibitor use: systematic review of global trends and practices
authors: Shanika LGT, Reynolds A, Pattison S, Braund R
population: 65 observational articles on oral PPI use in adults in 23 countries, covering 28 million users, searched to 31 March 2023; user numbers in each subcategory were summed
funder: University of Otago; open access funding enabled and organized by CAUL and its member institutions.
authorConflicts: The authors declare no competing interests.
result: Nearly one-quarter of adults use a PPI. Of users, 63% were younger than 65 years and 56% female; about 98% of users with dose data took at least one defined daily dose, and in three studies with common definitions 63.7% (143,466 of 225,280) took a higher dose such as omeprazole 40 mg daily, the figure the abstract reports as two-thirds at or above one defined daily dose; 25% continued for more than 1 year and 28% of these for more than 3 years.
